description: Reverse engineering: axonometric construction drawing of complex 3D steel frame
message: Build a calculation model from the attached drawing and engineering specification, then run static analysis. Ask for clarification instead of guessing any image information that cannot be identified reliably.
engineeringSpecification: Material Q345: E=206000 MPa, nu=0.3, density=7850 kg/m3, fy=345 MPa. Column members use section HW400x400 (H=400 mm, B=400 mm, tw=13 mm, tf=21 mm; A=0.021 m2, Iy=0.0006 m4, Iz=0.0006 m4, J=0.00003 m4, G=79000 MPa). Beam members use section HN600x200 (H=600 mm, B=200 mm, tw=11 mm, tf=17 mm; A=0.013 m2, Iy=0.0007 m4, Iz=0.00005 m4, J=0.000009 m4, G=79000 MPa). Use SI units and the global-z-up coordinate convention. Use only the load cases and load magnitudes annotated in the drawing; do not add member self-weight. Analyze load combination ULS = 1 x D.
